html.body: Date: 2025-05-09 PATENTAttorney Docket No. 19-1 114-US-DIV REMARKSApplicant notes, with appreciation, the Examiner's allowance of the application.Applicant submits the following comments regarding the Examiner's Reasons for Allowance stated within the Notice of Allowance.In the Reasons for Allowance, the Examiner characterizes and identifies particular features of the independent claims, and characterizes the cited references. Applicant does not concede that all the features, identified by the Examiner, are necessary to distinguish over the cited references or that the Examiner's characterization of the features of the claims is accurate.Applicant also asserts that the claims may be patentable for other reasons. Applicant also does not concede that the cited references are accurately characterized or that any of the cited references are relevant to the features of the claims.To the extent necessary, a petition for an extension of time under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136 is hereby made. Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account No. 50-1070 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.Respectfully submitted, HARRITY & HARRITY, LLPBy: /Nelson D. Nolte, Reg. No. 42,938/ Nelson D. Nolte Reg. No. 42,938
